items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: And then Fran, you know, went with the band.

ctx.x: And Kay sang with you what, then, in '46, or '45?

Or '45, in there in that vicinity. And then Fran, you know, went with the band. We went on the road. She went out to California, up through Canada, and then we were back in New York at the Aquarium, and I always thought Frannie was one of the best singers I ever heard. She of course went into the musical shows and things like that, but if you could have kept her singing -- she used to want to sing too high, the keys, and I used to keep her down, you know, in a lower key, and I thought she sounded much better…
